projects.title: ShadowGate
projects.description: HTTP/S command & control framework with AES-GCM encrypted beaconing, modular plugin architecture, and dynamic payload generation. Supports multi-client management, task queuing, encrypted exfiltration, and jitter-based beacon timing for OpSec.

projects.title: PhantomRecon
projects.description: Automated reconnaissance toolkit: subdomain enumeration via passive sources, port scanning with service fingerprinting, technology stack detection, and screenshot capture. Pipeline architecture with modular scanner plugins and structured JSON output.

projects.title: Wazuh Sentinel
projects.description: Custom SIEM detection engine: 40+ custom Wazuh rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK covering T1055 (Process Injection), T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1003 (Credential Dumping), and T1482 (Domain Trust Discovery). Automated alert triage pipeline with Slack notification routing.

projects.title: BinaryForge
projects.description: Binary exploitation framework: ROP chain builder, buffer overflow exploit generator, and format string vulnerability testing harness. Supports x86/x64 Linux targets with PIE/ASLR/NX bypass techniques and position-independent shellcode execution.

projects.title: PacketSentry
projects.description: Network intrusion detection system using raw sockets and BPF for real-time packet capture and analysis. Detects port scans, ARP spoofing, DNS tunneling, and SYN floods with custom signature-based alerting and PCAP export.

projects.title: ForgeProxy
projects.description: HTTP/HTTPS intercept proxy for web application testing. Request/response inspection, modification, and replay with built-in CA certificate generation for TLS interception. WebSocket support and automated fuzzing integration.

projects.title: CryptoBreach
projects.description: Cryptographic attack toolkit: implementations of Bleichenbacher's padding oracle attack, RSA timing side-channel, hash length extension, and format-preserving oracle attacks. Educational tool for understanding real-world crypto vulnerabilities.
